howItWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps to the gallery
howItWorks.awardsText: The championship rewards results, consistency and artistic sensitivity. The three works enter the Unseen Gallery archive together.

steps.title: Submit your work
steps.description: Every photographer can submit their best work. Upload your photo with a title, description and social profile.

steps.title: The daily duel
steps.description: Every day, two photographs selected by our team face each other in the Arena. The public votes.

steps.title: The winner faces the next
steps.description: The work with the most votes stays and faces a new challenger the following day. The chain continues throughout the month.

steps.title: Permanent gallery
steps.description: The work that wins the final Sunday of the month enters the permanent Unseen Gallery.

awards.label: 01 · Final champion
awards.title: Championship winner
awards.description: The prize goes to the work that reaches the end and wins the final duel of the month.

awards.label: 02 · Endurance
awards.title: Consecutive wins
awards.description: We recognize the work that builds the longest winning streak in the Arena during the month.

awards.label: 03 · Editorial choice
awards.title: Chosen by Unseen
awards.description: The Unseen team awards a special prize to the work that best interprets our artistic vision.
